name: dayz-n-chill
description: DayZ n' Chill's plugin marketplace. Currently hosts Agentic-Z (AI agent stack for DayZ modding); future DayZ-modding plugins from the same org will land here too.

plugins.name: agentic-z
plugins.description: AI agent stack for DayZ modding. After install, run /dayz-init for a guided setup wizard that takes you from empty repo to mod-loaded-in-DayZ. Ships specialist subagents and DayZ slash skills covering the full mod pipeline (preflight, scaffold, build PBO, launch test, types.xml, RAG indexer), plus the dayz-rag MCP server for semantic search over vanilla DayZ source.

plugins.name: agentic-z-panel
plugins.description: Side panel for Agentic-Z: DayZ status at a glance and one-click buttons for mount P:, build, the build and in game checks, deploy, launch, stop, Workbench, Object Builder, test logs, the health page and the release pack, and a field that asks /dayz-ask a vanilla question, with no model tokens spent.
